001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
004
005import java.util.List;
006
007public interface Event extends Spectatable {
008
009    /**
010     * Get the starter of the event.
011     * @return The starter of the event
012     */
013    Object getStarter();
014
015    /**
016     * Get the players of the match.
017     * @return The players of the match
018     */
019    List<Player> getPlayers();
020
021    /**
022     * Get the spectators of the match.
023     * @return The spectators of the match
024     */
025    List<Player> getSpectators();
026
027    /**
028     * Get the amount of players that the event has started with.
029     * @return The amount of players that the event has started with
030     */
031    int getStartPlayerCount();
032
033    /**
034     * Get the winner of the event.
035     * @return The winner of the event
036     */
037    Player getWinner();
038
039}
